prompts.menu:
Use case: style-transfer. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the approved NightBrand graphical UI family. Create a NEW PRODUCTION TYPOGRAPHY SPRITE ATLAS, not a concept board. Real transparent alpha background. ONLY isolated original hand-drawn ivory Gothic words, absolutely NO frames, banners, panels, grid lines, labels, shadows outside lettering, backgrounds, checkerboard, logos or decorative separators. Use precisely the same beautiful elegant slim pointed blackletter handwriting as the reference: aged bone ivory, subtle ink texture, angular stems and finely cut Gothic terminals, excellent readability, restrained ornate initial capitals, no heavy gold bevel or flames. Every phrase uses the SAME letterform design. Polish diacritics must be correct. Flat front view, crisp clean edges. Arrange each phrase as a single centered horizontal line inside its own evenly spaced grid cell. Wide transparent gutters between words and between rows. NO text may touch or cross another cell. Transparent outer margins. Each listed phrase must occur ONCE, with no other text. Uniform visual cap height as far as fitting long phrases permits. This atlas will be consumed directly by a game and MUST have clear separated rows and columns.
Canvas landscape, preferably 2048×1536. Exactly TWO columns and SIX rows, in the exact order below; left column is Polish, right column English. Make each word large enough to read when scaled to a menu label about 250 pixels wide. Grid cells equal height; whitespace surrounding all lettering.
ROW 1 LEFT "Kontynuuj" RIGHT "Continue"
ROW 2 LEFT "Podróż" RIGHT "Journey"
ROW 3 LEFT "Kaplica" RIGHT "Shrine"
ROW 4 LEFT "Kronika" RIGHT "Chronicle"
ROW 5 LEFT "Instrukcja" RIGHT "Guide"
ROW 6 LEFT "Opcje" RIGHT "Options"
Spell all twelve EXACTLY as quoted. Do NOT include the words row, left, right, Polish, English, or quotation marks. Preserve the accented ó and ż in Podróż.

prompts.panel: Use case: style-transfer. Reference image is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Produce ONE isolated production UI asset in the SAME restrained elegant dark Gothic NightBrand family as that board. Real transparent background outside the component, preserve a clean alpha channel. No text, letters, numbers, logo, mockup, palette swatches, labels, drop shadows outside the shape, extra components or other objects. Flat orthographic front view. Very fine subdued antique-brass linework, quiet charcoal ink/smoked vellum texture, tiny pointed/lancet/lozenge corner details. Dark, delicate, premium through proportion and craft; NOT bulky carved metal. NO skulls, chains, weapons, fire, bright gold, bright glow, heavy bevel, baroque curls. Generous readable empty interior. Asset: a SINGLE wide rectangular PANEL FRAME, approx 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 1536×1024. Very thin continuous hairline border, four tiny Gothic tracery corners and restrained midpoint notches, consistent fine stroke thickness. The outermost frame sits close to the canvas edges with only a very small even transparent margin. The entire large center is fully transparent and empty, no fill. Corners take up at most 7% of width and 9% of height. All four straight edges must stay straight and symmetrical; edges can be stretched with a 9-slice UI system. Only ONE frame.

prompts.selected:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the isolated empty Gothic UI button. Create its selected / hovered counterpart for NightBrand.
Preserve EXACTLY the same canvas dimensions, placement, silhouette, thin brass outline, all corner geometry, edge coordinates, material grain, and the existing real transparency outside the button. Keep all four corners and the outline aligned with the input, so the two states swap without any positional shift.
Change ONLY the center charcoal surface: add a very restrained deep desaturated oxblood / burgundy tint, strongest in the center and softly darkening toward the ends, like aged wine-dark linen seen in low light. Make the thin existing brass edge slightly more legible, by at most 10%. It should be quiet, elegant and dark, not luminous or bright red. Do not add any new ornaments, highlights, symbols or text. No flames, no glows, no shadows outside. Blank center. Real transparent background.
